axis.definition: one dot per acquisition, on the acquisition day; the chain is strictly interleaved (four pass geometries, one acquisition each) and no day carries two acquisitions
axis.name: acquisition_day

brightness_ratio.note: a ratio of two powers - bounded, and the most geometry-stable channel here (the four geometries' own pre medians span 1.07x). It is intensity over a per-geometry constant, so as a time series it says exactly what the intensity panel says.
brightness_ratio.title: brightness ratio - brightness_ratio

coherence.note: a second, differently named coherence column of the export: empty on 8 of the 241 drawn rows (4 in the repair, 4 in the post stride).
coherence.title: coherence - the export's coherence

coherence_gamma2.note: the pipeline's coherence column of the window. The mask rule of this package cannot be re-run offline on a record whose payload is external, so this panel draws the export's number and never claims it for the rule.
coherence_gamma2.title: gamma2 - coherence_gamma2

intensity.note: a window power (an unnormalised brightness), so it carries the geometry and the sensor as well as the bridge.
intensity.title: intensity - the window's intensity

phase_coherence.note: the pipeline's phase coherence. Positive on all 241 drawn rows, and geometry-dependent.
phase_coherence.title: phase coherence - phase_coherence

phase_scatterer_count.note: a count of the window's phase scatterers. It is the second most geometry-stable channel of the six: the four geometries' own pre medians span 1.22x (0.870 .. 1.059 of the pooled base).
phase_scatterer_count.title: scatterers - phase_scatterer_count

not_read: the ~250 MB echo-window payload: never opened, so coherence_gamma2 here is the export's own column and never the mask rule's gamma2
no SLC, no network, no cache

plate.S1C_rule: a dotted vertical at the platform change, a coverage fact
plate.dot_colour: pass geometry (two sub-swaths x two orbits)
drawn_bands: every step longer than the cadence (grey)
levels_drawn: each geometry's own pre-window median (solid rule, inside the pre window)
plate.lines_between_dots: none - the four geometries alternate on a 2.3-day mean step, so a line would draw the interleave
plate.scale_rule: all six channels are drawn on a log ordinate: every one of them is strictly positive on every drawn row (a squared coherence, a count, a ratio, a power), so no ordinate of this plate can reach 0 and the gamma2 panel alone spans four decades.
